feedback.end: Conservation is the protection of animals, plants and their habitats from the damage caused by humans and natural events.

end.text: Rainforests are one of the most important habitats in the world. Despite only covering 6% of the Earth’s surface, rainforests are home to around half of the planet’s animal and plant life.

instruction.text: Deeper into the rainforest, David has discovered lots of chopped down trees. Select one of the stumps to find out more.

end.text: One of the greatest threats to the rainforest is deforestation. This is the removal of trees to clear space for things such as farms or roads.
end.sound: One of the greatest threats to the rain-forest is deforestation. This is the removal of trees to clear space for things such as farms or roads.

instruction.text: Match the cause of deforestation to its explanation.

atoms.b: Large areas of trees are cleared for cattle farms.
Miners remove trees to create space for mining pits.
Illegal loggers chop down trees inside protected areas.
Trees are destroyed in the process of building new roads and towns.

instruction.text: David has now come across a sign in another area of the rainforest. Select the sign to find out more.

end.text: To combat deforestation, different strategies have been introduced to conserve the rainforest. One example is the creation of national parks, which aim to protect rainforest wildlife.
end.sound: To combat deforestation, different strategies have been introduced to conserve the rain-forest. One example is the creation of national parks, which aim to protect rainforest wildlife.

instruction.text: Match the conservation strategy to its picture.

feedback.end: Selective logging involves carefully choosing which trees to remove. There are still negative impacts, but it is more sustainable than cutting down all the trees in an area.
National parks are protected areas that aim to preserve habitats and rainforest wildlife.
Ecotourism is centred around the conservation of the rainforest and tries to positively contribute to the environment.
Buying local and plant-based food, as well as products that are approved by environmental organisations, also helps to conserve the rainforest.
